name: Goli Baje
subtitle: soft, tangy gram flour dumplings from the Mangalore coast

ingredients.note: sour curd is what gives goli baje its tang and its lift

prepNotes: Also sold as Mangalore bajji. The batter must be thick enough to hold a rough ball dropped from the fingers.
The batter needs a rest of at least 2 hours. That fermentation is the difference between light and leaden.

steps.text: Whisk the yogurt smooth and mix in both flours, salt and the soda into a thick batter.
Rest, covered, 2 to 3 hours at room temperature until it looks aerated.
Fold in the green chilli, ginger, curry leaves and coconut slivers.
Drop rough balls into medium-hot oil using wet fingers.
steps.tip: Medium heat. Too hot and they brown before the middle sets.

steps.text: Fry 5 minutes, turning, until deep gold all over. Drain and serve hot with coconut chutney.

storage: Eat within the hour. They deflate and toughen as they cool and do not reheat convincingly.
